digest.component_or_area: grounding metric detector engine (Engine B backend)
propositions: _metric_invoke invokes scc without --by-file flag, causing scc to return language summaries with empty Files arrays instead of per-file entries
_scc_files parser consumes only per-file entries from Files array and yields no results when Files is empty, preventing metric match emission
The grounding metric detector can never emit documented over-800-LOC file matches because the threshold loop never executes when _scc_files yields no entries
Adding --by-file to the scc command invocation restores per-file JSON output and enables the detector to correctly identify and emit matches for files exceeding the cutoff
Existing fail-open semantics for tool absence, timeout, nonzero exit, and invalid JSON remain unchanged by the fix
